# Chanakya — independent software engineer

> Chanakya (Nagulagam Chanakya) is an independent software engineer in Warangal, India. He builds websites, online stores, booking systems, data and automation work, and custom business software including quoting engines and operational workflows.

## Capabilities
- Websites & online stores: A landing page, a site for your business, or a store that takes orders. Fast on a phone, built to be found in search, and the code is yours at the end.
- Booking systems, forms & fixes: An appointment or booking system, an enquiry form that reaches you instead of a spreadsheet, or a repair to something you already have and can't change yourself.
- Data, research & automation: Tools that go and find what you need — business and contact data, checks on sites that already exist, scheduled reports — and put it somewhere you can act on. Plus joining the tools you already pay for so nobody is copying between them by hand.
- Custom business systems: Quoting and pricing engines, approval workflows that stay locked until a stage is signed off, internal dashboards and client portals. Software shaped to rules that are specific to how you work.

## Who it is for
Any business that needs software built, from a single landing page to a system the whole company runs on. No industry restriction. Budgets from small one-off jobs through to long builds.

## How a project runs
1. Discovery call: 20 minutes, free. An honest evaluation of whether custom software makes business sense.
2. Scope & Fixed Quote: Based on problem size and workflow complexity, a transparent fixed-price quote and timeline before any build begins.
3. Build & Handover: Direct engineering around real data, staff stress testing, and live deployment. The client receives 100% repository and database ownership.

## Work
- Trelio (https://trelio.in): Chanakya's own product — he founded it and he builds it. A client portal and milestone payment authorization platform.
- Apex Packaging & Converting: A reference build demonstrating an industrial CPQ estimating platform for packaging converters. Source: https://github.com/Chanakya2006gt/Industrial-packaging-platform
- Lead Engine: Chanakya's own tool for finding clients and auditing their websites. Local-first, not deployed. Source: https://github.com/Chanakya2006gt/Lead_Gen_Agency
